system.description: Duration: 6 turns Effect: Creates movable invisible eye This spell creates an invisible eye through which the caster can see. It is the size of a real eye and has infravision (60' range). The wizard eye floats through the air at up to 120' per turn, but will not go through solid objects nor move more than 240' away from the caster. The spellcaster must concentrate (without moving) to see through the eye.
